breakdown.description: The prompt ignores the product of inertia even though the setup explicitly gives a nonzero I_yz and the unsymmetric bending formula depends on it.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly applies the full unsymmetric bending formula including the product of inertia Iyz = 800000 mm^4. It does not include the erroneous instruction from the incomplete prompt to 'superpose M_y z / I_y and M_z y / I_z as though the product of inertia were zero.' Instead, it directly uses the correct formula σ = -(My·Iz − Mz·Iyz)/(Iy·Iz − Iyz^2) · z + -(Mz·Iy − My·Iyz)/(Iy·Iz − Iyz^2) · y, which properly accounts for the nonzero product of inertia, matching the ground truth.
